description: Two-stage variant of Adapt: vocabulary and intents are filed under a domain == skill_id, a top-level classifier picks the domain first, then only that domain's sub-engine matches the intent. Same distribution and confidence gate as adapt-medium, registered under a separate opm.pipeline entry point (HierarchicalAdaptPipeline in ovos_adapt/opm.py).
notes: Same medium-confidence gate and thresholds as adapt-medium; isolates the two-stage routing shape from the flat pipeline. Hypothesis: domain-first routing should help precision on large multi-domain intent sets by rejecting cross-domain keyword near-misses before they compete, and be roughly neutral-to-worse on small single-domain sets where there is no domain structure to exploit.
